Sam (People Ops): Lina asked about a 5-week workation: relocating to Austin Mon5/12 through Fri6/16, keeping NY payroll. Does this trigger WFH stipend changes or tax withholding?

Lina (Engineer): Correct. Keeping NY payroll for now. Will be in Austin weekdays for 5 weeks for family.

Priya (Payroll): Short answer: file a temporary location entry. For stays over 30 days we check state withholding. Austin/Tx has no state income tax, so withholding stays NY payroll unless you officially switch. But we need the temp-form so we have records.

Sam (People Ops): Logistics: inventory can ship a monitor if you mark it temporary shipment. Stipend: WFH allowance remains tied to declared home_base; temporary entries do not auto-move stipend, but we can pro-rate a short-term stipend if requested.

Lina (Engineer): I'll submit the form and request monitor shipment.

ops-inventory-bot: Inventory note created for Lina: monitor (temp shipment) - return date set 2026-06-01.

Priya (Payroll): Please attach lodging address and exact dates on the temp form. We'll run withholding check once submitted.

Sam (People Ops): I'll add a short FAQ blurb about short out-of-state workations and stipend behavior and drop link here when live.

Lina (Engineer): Thanks everyone, filing now. :thumbsup:
